facts.fact: ZamPortal says the Government Service Bus is a national platform that digitally integrates all government institutions, departments and agencies, deployed by the SMART Zambia Institute's Electronic Government Division.

systems.owner: Electronic Government Division, SMART Zambia Institute

facts.fact: ZamPortal, the government platform on the GSB, hosts 322 services that citizens can access and apply for online, per its director Beaton Sibulowa.
Sibulowa confirms ZamPortal has recorded over 3.7 million transactions and generated 5 billion Kwacha since its inception.

systems.owner: Electronic Government Division, SMART Zambia Institute

ZMB.note: No national ID sign-in is stated, so no gateway fact.

facts.fact: The Electronic Government Division of the SMART Zambia Institute deployed the Government Service Bus and ZamPortal, which host government services across institutions.
